photo-resize.name: Exam Photo Resizer
photo-resize.tagline: UPSC, SSC, NEET, JEE - exact pixel + KB specs
photo-resize.description: Upload a photo, pick the exam, and get a portal-ready JPG with the right pixel size, KB target and white background.

image-compress.name: Image Compressor
image-compress.description: Compress any image to a precise KB size - 20 KB, 50 KB, 200 KB or any custom target. Within ±5 KB of your goal.

document-photo.name: Document Photo Maker
document-photo.tagline: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, OCI, Voter ID
document-photo.description: Identity-document photos at exact spec - dimensions, KB and white background. Ready for the portal.

photo-signature-joiner.name: Photo + Signature Joiner
photo-signature-joiner.tagline: Combine for SSC and IBPS uploads
photo-signature-joiner.description: Merge a photo and signature into a single image at portal-standard dimensions. Side-by-side or stacked.

print-sheet.name: Print Sheet Generator
print-sheet.description: Lay out passport-size photos on a 4×6 inch or A4 sheet with cutting guides. Print at home or any studio.

jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG / Image to PDF
jpg-to-pdf.description: Stitch one or many images into a PDF, reorder pages, rotate as needed. A4 or Letter, portrait or landscape.

pdf-compress.name: PDF Compressor
pdf-compress.tagline: Shrink PDFs to fit the upload limit
pdf-compress.description: Re-encodes embedded photos and strips metadata to hit form-portal upload limits. Light, recommended or stronger - your call.

pdf-merge-split.name: PDF Merge & Split
pdf-merge-split.tagline: Combine PDFs or split by page ranges
pdf-merge-split.description: Merge several PDFs into one, or split a PDF into separate files using page ranges like '1-3, 5, 7-9'. All in-browser.

print-job-slip.name: Print Job Slip
print-job-slip.description: Pick files, set copies, color or B&W, sides and page ranges. Outputs one PDF starting with a cover sheet the print shop can read at a glance.

image-format-convert.name: Image Format Converter
image-format-convert.tagline: JPG ↔ PNG ↔ WebP, in your browser
image-format-convert.description: Convert between JPG, PNG and WebP. JPG flattens transparency to white for portal compatibility.

qr-generate.name: QR Code Generator
qr-generate.tagline: Make a QR for a URL, UPI ID or contact
qr-generate.description: Type the text — get a clean, downloadable QR code. Works for URLs, UPI IDs, phone numbers, plain text. PNG download.

photo-grayscale.name: Photo Grayscale Converter
photo-grayscale.tagline: Convert a colour photo to clean black & white
photo-grayscale.description: Some sarkari portals and print shops want greyscale. One click, on-device, no quality loss.

aadhaar-collage.name: Aadhaar Front + Back Collage
aadhaar-collage.tagline: Combine both sides on a single A4 sheet
aadhaar-collage.description: Stack front and back of an Aadhaar card on one A4 page — ready for portals that ask for both sides as a single upload.

quick-send.name: Quick Send
quick-send.tagline: Send files to a print shop - scan a QR, no app, no number
quick-send.description: Browser-to-browser file transfer. Print-shop opens Quick Send, customer scans the QR with their phone and sends files directly. P2P - files never stored on a server.
